gloss: to arrange; to prepare; to put in order

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {整|ととの}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to arrange; to put in order
definitions.explanation: To organize things neatly or make adjustments for proper alignment.
To make necessary preparations or gather requirements.
To bring into a balanced or healthy state.

notes:
{整|ととの}える is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to put things in proper order.

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: ⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧ (to be arranged, to be ready)
- {整|ととの}える: I arrange the room.
- ⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧: The preparations are complete.

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{整|ととの}え→整う：03935_totonou⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates the arranging process is ongoing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整|ととの}える — to arrange/prepare [thing]
- [condition]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整|ととの}える — to regulate/condition [condition]
- ⟦{身|み}だしなみ→身だしなみ：14286_midashinami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整|ととの}える (groom oneself)
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整|ととの}える (prepare the environment)
- ⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整|ととの}える (regulate breathing)
- ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{整|ととの}える (condition one's health)

SAUNA CULTURE:
⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧ has become popular in sauna culture, referring to the blissful state achieved after alternating hot and cold bathing.
